name: Emerging Technologies and Their Applications in Engineering
objectives: Provide brief knowledge about the emerging technologies of the present time which are changing the world at a speed humanity has never seen, e.g. 3D printing, 5G technology, virtual reality, fortification, cyber security and many others.
outcomes: CO1 Be familiar with 3D printing, robots and drones.
CO2 Know and be familiar with developments in transport systems like Hyperloop and Maglev.
CO3 Understand the need of fast internet and its application in various fields; understand nanotechnology and ceramics.
CO4 Know the basics of Artificial Intelligence and machine learning, blockchain and quantum computing.
CO5 Know augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), cyber security and satellite technology.
ref: Mastering Cloud Computing: Foundations and Applications Programming, Christian Vecchiola, Rajkumar Buyya and S. Thamarai Selvi
Daniel Drescher, Blockchain Basics: A Non-Technical Introduction in 25 Steps
Ian Gibson, Additive Manufacturing Technologies: 3D Printing, Rapid Prototyping and Direct Digital Manufacturing
Barry Davies, Build a Drone: A Step-by-Step Guide to Designing, Constructing, and Flying Your Very Own Drone
Simon Haykin, "Communication Systems", 4th Edition, Wiley India
K. C. Mahajan, R. Kumar & P. K. Pattnaik, Robotics for Engineers - Concepts and Techniques, Vikas Publishing House
Michael A. Nielsen, "Quantum Computation and Quantum Information", Cambridge University Press
Joel Grus, "Data Science from Scratch: First Principles with Python", O'Reilly Media

exps.title: Modern Manufacturing: 3D printing, study of 3D printer, generation of stl files, making small objects on 3D printer, basics of Ceramic material
exps.aim: Study a 3D printer, generate an STL file from a CAD model and print a small object.
exps.apparatus: 3D printer (FDM), filament, CAD software, slicer software
exps.formula: CAD model → STL → slicing (G-code) → layer-by-layer printing
viva: What is an STL file?
A triangulated-surface file format describing a 3D model for printing.
Name a 3D printing process.
FDM (fused deposition modelling), SLA, SLS.

exps.title: Robotics: Introduction about different types of robots, Study components of a real robot, Power point presentation on different robotic applications
exps.aim: Study types of robots and the components of a real robot; present applications.
exps.formula: Robot = sensors + controller + actuators + power supply + end effector
viva: Name the components of a robot.
Manipulator/arm, end effector, sensors, controller, actuators and power source.
What is degree of freedom?
Number of independent motions a robot joint set can perform.

exps.title: Drones and their applications in various fields
exps.aim: Study parts of a drone and its uses in agriculture, surveying, delivery and defence.
exps.formula: Parts: frame, motors, propellers, ESC, flight controller, battery, radio
viva: What does a flight controller do?
Stabilises the drone using sensor data and controls the motors.
Give two drone applications.
Aerial photography and crop spraying.

exps.title: Scope of developments in transport systems: Hyperloop, Magnetic leviathan (Maglev) by model making or using computer animation
exps.aim: Make a model or animation showing how Hyperloop and Maglev work.
exps.apparatus: Model materials or animation software, magnets
exps.formula: Maglev: magnetic levitation removes wheel friction; Hyperloop: pods in low-pressure tube
viva: How does Maglev float?
Magnetic repulsion or attraction lifts the train above the guideway.
Why is the Hyperloop tube at low pressure?
To reduce air drag.

exps.title: Introduction to 5G technology: Benefits of 5G in IOT and other applications, Comparison with 2G, 3G, 4G
exps.aim: Compare generations of mobile networks and note 5G benefits for IoT.
exps.formula: 5G: high speed, very low latency (~1 ms), massive device density
viva: Give two benefits of 5G.
Very high data rate and low latency.
Which 'G' introduced data/internet at scale?
3G (and 4G for broadband/LTE).

exps.title: Study of fortification machines for Rice and other cereals with the help of Videos and animation tools
exps.aim: Understand how nutrients are added to rice and cereals using machines.
exps.formula: Fortification = adding micronutrients (iron, folic acid, B12) to staple food
viva: What is food fortification?
Adding essential vitamins and minerals to foods to improve nutrition.
Name a fortified staple.
Fortified rice, wheat flour or salt.

exps.title: Nanotechnology: Introduction to Nano materials and brief theory of nanotechnology
exps.aim: Learn what nanomaterials are and how their properties differ.
exps.formula: 1 nm = 10⁻⁹ m; nano scale ≈ 1–100 nm; surface-to-volume ratio rises as size falls
viva: What is a nanomaterial?
A material with at least one dimension in the 1–100 nm range.
Why do properties change at nano scale?
High surface-to-volume ratio and quantum effects.

exps.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine learning: Introduction, applications, challenges and threats associated
exps.aim: Study AI/ML basics, applications and risks.
exps.apparatus: Python / online ML demo tools, presentation
viva: Difference between AI and ML?
ML is a subset of AI where systems learn patterns from data.
Name a challenge of AI.
Bias, privacy, job impact, or lack of explainability.

exps.title: Blockchain and Distributed ledger technology: what is blockchain, its application, cryptocurrencies
exps.aim: Understand blocks, hashes, chain and cryptocurrencies.
exps.formula: Block = data + hash + previous hash; changing one block breaks the chain
viva: What is a blockchain?
A distributed, tamper-evident ledger of blocks linked by hashes.
Name a cryptocurrency.
Bitcoin or Ethereum.

exps.title: Quantum computing: its practical application, Building Quantum dice
exps.aim: Learn qubit basics and build a quantum dice (random number) demo.
exps.apparatus: Quantum simulator (e.g. IBM Quantum / Qiskit), computer
exps.formula: Qubit state |ψ⟩ = α|0⟩ + β|1⟩, |α|² + |β|² = 1; n qubits in superposition give 2ⁿ outcomes
viva: What is a qubit?
The quantum unit of information that can be in a superposition of 0 and 1.
How does a quantum dice work?
Put qubits in superposition with Hadamard gates and measure to get a random outcome.

exps.title: Electric vehicle: development of simple battery system in laboratory
exps.aim: Assemble a simple battery pack and study its voltage and capacity.
exps.apparatus: Cells, holder, multimeter, connecting wires, charger
exps.formula: Series: V = V1 + V2 + ...; Parallel: capacity adds (Ah); Energy = V × Ah
viva: Series vs parallel cells?
Series adds voltage; parallel adds capacity.
Which battery type is common in EVs?
Lithium-ion.

exps.title: Other Future trends: Cyber security, Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality, Data sciences
exps.aim: Survey cyber security, AR/VR and data science trends.
viva: Difference between AR and VR?
AR overlays digital content on the real world; VR creates a fully virtual environment.
What is phishing?
Tricking users into revealing sensitive information through fake messages or sites.

exps.title: Different types of satellites and their application using videos and Power point presentations
exps.aim: Study satellite orbits (LEO, MEO, GEO) and applications.
exps.formula: GEO orbit height ≈ 35,786 km above the equator (period 24 h)
viva: Name types of satellites.
Communication, navigation, weather, earth observation and scientific.
What is a geostationary satellite?
One that stays fixed over a point on the equator, orbiting at ≈ 35,786 km.
